claim_tested: AfErg10A is a bidirectional acetoacetyl-CoA thiolase and the gene is essential
key_finding: Reversible synthetic and degradative thiolase activity; Km CoA 26 uM, acetoacetyl-CoA 43 uM, acetyl-CoA 232 uM; erg10A deletion lethal
context: A. fumigatus, recombinant protein and gene deletion
limitation: No 2-methylacetoacetyl-CoA or longer 3-ketoacyl-CoA substrate tested, so pathway assignment is not constrained by the kinetics

key_finding: Functional C-terminal GFP fusion colocalises with mitochondrial dye in hyphae
limitation: Colocalisation does not resolve matrix versus inner membrane

citation: This work, UniProt proteome UP000002530 + InterPro
stance: refutes a premise of the seed hypothesis
claim_tested: A. fumigatus lacks a CoA-transferase, making acetoacetate use impossible
key_finding: Three full-length family I 3-oxoacid CoA-transferases: Q4WLU8 (AFUA_6G12250, 518 aa, 56.6% id to human OXCT1), Q4WK09 (AFUA_1G04120, 504 aa, 54.0%), Q4WEZ2 (AFUA_3G04030, 526 aa, 48.6%); all IPR014388 / PF01144; calibration OXCT1 vs OXCT2 74.6%
context: Af293 reference proteome, Smith-Waterman BLOSUM62 gap 11/1
limitation: Sequence presence is not activity; none of the three has been assayed

citation: This work, presequence and PTS2 scan
claim_tested: The three SCOTs and the leucine genes are mitochondrial
key_finding: N-terminal net charge +6, +7, +6 for the three SCOTs, no PTS2; mitochondrial control median +5 versus cytosolic median 0, Mann-Whitney U = 34.5, one-sided p = 0.0031 (n = 7 vs 5)
limitation: Charge heuristic, not a cleavage-site predictor or an import assay

citation: This work, comparative genomics, 15 fungal proteomes
claim_tested: The fungal CoA-transferase serves a leucine-derived acetoacetate route
key_finding: SCOT presence and the HMG-CoA lyase plus MCC module agree in 14/15 proteomes, Fisher two-sided p = 0.0088; PF00108 complement median 6 (SCOT+) versus 1 (SCOT-), Mann-Whitney one-sided p = 0.0053
context: UniProt reference proteomes, largely electronic EC annotation
limitation: U. maydis returns 0 PF00108 thiolases, which is implausible and shows annotation sparsity in the negatives

claim_tested: Erg10A performs the terminal step of mitochondrial beta-oxidation
key_finding: Erg10A is ACAT clade: 50.1% to human ACAT1, 47.4% to yeast Erg10, but 36.1% to ACAA2 and 35.6% to ACAA1. Four separate A. fumigatus thiolases are ACAA clade (Q4WG79 54.4%, Q4X135 51.0%, Q4WPY9 49.5%, E9RBL5 49.2% to ACAA1)
limitation: Clade identity predicts chain-length preference imperfectly

claim_tested: A dedicated mitochondrial beta-oxidation thiolase exists that is not Erg10A
key_finding: E9RBL5 (RLSSLLNHL at 5) and Q4WPY9 (RLSQVSSHF at 7) carry PTS2 and are peroxisomal; Q4WG79 has no PTS2 and net charge +6, the mitochondrial pattern
context: Consensus [RK]-[LVIQ]-x(5)-[HQ]-[LAF] within residues 1-35, validated on human ACAA1, yeast Pot1, human PHYH
limitation: Prediction only; Q4WG79 localisation has not been tested

evidence_type: experimental, gene deletion in a related species
claim_tested: Loss of the mitochondrial beta-oxidation thiolase is lethal
key_finding: Aspergillus mitochondrial beta-oxidation mutants are viable with conditional carbon-source phenotypes
limitation: Different species; A. fumigatus orthologue not deleted

citation: This work, HMG-CoA synthase presequence analysis
claim_tested: A. fumigatus runs mammalian-style mitochondrial ketogenesis via an HMGCS2 orthologue
key_finding: Both HMG-CoA synthases look cytosolic: Erg13A Q4WBQ3 net 0, Erg13B Q4WXT8 net -2, against mitochondrial control median +5
limitation: Heuristic; HMG-CoA for the mitochondrial pool could come from leucine instead of from a synthase

citation: This work, UniProt EC 1.1.1.30 search + alignment
claim_tested: A. fumigatus can interconvert acetoacetate and 3-hydroxybutyrate
key_finding: The sole EC 1.1.1.30 candidate Q4WUQ4 is 22.3% identical to human BDH1 and is a generic short-chain dehydrogenase/reductase
limitation: Low identity does not exclude convergent activity

key_finding: 2-methylacetoacetyl-CoA cleavage is the discriminating property of human T2 among thiolases
limitation: The corresponding measurement on Erg10A has never been made, so the isoleucine route can be neither confirmed nor excluded

claim_tested: Branch assignment PTHR18919:SF156 predicts an ACAT1-like substrate range
key_finding: Of 14 UniProt-annotated ACAT1 functional residues: Erg10A 9/14, Erg10B 9/14, cytosolic yeast Erg10 12/14, ACAT2 6/14, ACAA2 6/14. The annotated set including the K+-site Tyr219 is clade-wide
limitation: The residues that confer 2-methyl acceptance in T2 are not among the annotated set, so this test cannot decide the question

citation: This work, QuickGO annotation pull for Q4WLA8
claim_tested: Current GO annotation covers the biology
key_finding: GO:0003985 MF (EXP from PMID:32005728, plus IBA PTN000432235, plus IEA), GO:0005739 CC (EXP plus IBA plus IEA), GO:0016746/GO:0016747 IEA. No biological process annotation exists

citation: UniProt Q4WLA8 PATHWAY line versus FUNCTION comment
claim_tested: Erg10A is the first step of mevalonate biosynthesis
key_finding: PATHWAY states '(R)-mevalonate biosynthesis; (R)-mevalonate from acetyl-CoA: step 1/3' attributed to PMID:32005728, while the FUNCTION comment on the same entry says Erg10A 'seems not to be involved in ergosterol biosynthesis'
limitation: None; this is an internal inconsistency in the entry

key_finding: Top partners erg13A/erg13B 0.987, three SCOTs 0.946, HMG-CoA lyases 0.928, all with dscore 0.900-0.947 and escore 0.000-0.233
limitation: Database-channel scores are annotation carry-over and cannot be used as independent evidence

citation: This work, RCSB full-text search and SIFTS
claim_tested: No experimental structure exists for this protein
key_finding: PDB 6L2C (2.44 A, CoA complex) and 6L2G (2.41 A, apo) are AfErg10A structures, but SIFTS maps them to B0XMC1 (A1163 AFUB_000550), so they never appear on the Af293 entry Q4WLA8

claim_tested: The A. fumigatus CoA-transferases are the known propionyl-CoA detoxification enzyme
key_finding: The Ach1-type enzyme is a separate non-homologous gene, Q4WC63 (AFUA_8G05580, PF02550/PF13336), distinct from the three PF01144 SCOTs
context: Fungal CoA-transferase literature plus this work's Pfam assignment
